contracts.name: safe configured target identity
contracts.evidence: Every opened session and frame exposed alias, hashed fingerprint, desktop layer, and configured-target attestation without returning the endpoint or explicit machine id.

contracts.name: approval target binding
contracts.evidence: Direct-burst approval requests carried the same machine identity and the action digest included session id plus target fingerprint.

contracts.name: managed target continuity
contracts.evidence: A changed target fingerprint blocked the managed harness before verification and could not be resumed in the same run.

contracts.name: direct MCP target continuity
contracts.evidence: A changed target fingerprint latched the visible direct-MCP run blocked and refused its next mutating call.

contracts.name: manual input epoch revocation
contracts.evidence: A reported human cursor move incremented every live session control epoch; a burst planned under the earlier epoch executed zero HID calls.

contracts.name: concurrent client exclusion
contracts.evidence: A second machine client incremented the epoch and returned control_changed before any HID call.

contracts.name: responsive operator visibility
contracts.evidence: A real browser showed the fingerprint, machine alias, VNC compatibility layer, live frame, frame/world/epoch, transaction, timeline, pause, and stop at desktop and 390x844.

contracts.name: live-stream graceful shutdown
contracts.evidence: With an authenticated run-event stream held open, one SIGINT shut down the harness in 0.417 seconds. The server emitted no forced-timeout error or traceback, the stream client exited normally, and no second signal was needed.

includes: inline image unpack and artifact write

limitations: The fingerprint proves continuity with configured target selection; it is not hardware or guest attestation.
Foreground process, focused control, and nested guest identity still require observer or visual evidence.
The latency sample uses a fake computer and is a local integration diagnostic, not a service-level objective.
